title: Biology Conversation Challenge: Roleplay and TA Practice
objective: Students combine vocabulary, pronunciation, questions, and confidence in practical speaking tasks.
context: A visitor asks a teaching assistant about a campus garden. The sign lists two animals: butterflies and bees.

items.prompt: Visitor: greet the assistant and ask what lives here.
items.answer: Accept a polite greeting and a clear question about the place.
items.hint: Try: Hello. Which animals can I see here?

items.prompt: Assistant: name both animals. Visitor: ask a follow-up question.
items.answer: Answer mentions butterflies and bees; question fits either animal.
items.hint: Ask Where, When, or How many.

items.prompt: Close the conversation. Write one thing you did well and one thing to practise.
items.answer: Accept a polite closing and one specific strength and next step.
items.hint: Try: Thank you. Next time I will ___.
